purpose: Can ordinary FNO distinguish two material maps at the same source before scaling to many workpieces?
model: BasicFNO eight channels, extra channels zero, width4 layers4 modes16/8/64 padding0
target: FD(gamma)-FD(1), same labels in both arms
normalization: unchanged old train-only full-field and trace RMS
sample_order: alternate the two workpieces, identical in both arms
selection: fixed final update800, intermediate100/200/400 diagnostic only
reference: arithmetic mean of the two training residual targets; optimal material-independent prediction for equal-weight quadratic losses at identical non-material inputs
metrics: training field/receiver supervised objective vs exact mean-target oracle
full and scatter errors on both fitted samples
interpretation: Feasibility/conditioning diagnostic only, not generalization or an isolated workpiece-count causal comparison with historical runs. Mean target uses fitted truth and is not a deployable baseline. No physical-gradient or FWI claim.
feasibility: non-material inputs identical; actual training trace pair difference/mean norm=0.33885473012924194
